title: The 13th constellation
caption: The Sun crosses 13 constellations. Astrology uses 12 equal signs. Both are true.

beats.head: The Sun passes through *thirteen* constellations, not twelve.
The thirteenth is *Ophiuchus*, the serpent bearer.
beats.sub: The Sun crosses it in late November and early December.

beats.head: Astrology uses twelve *equal* signs, thirty degrees each.
They start at the *March equinox*, not the star shapes.
beats.sub: The signs are seasons of the sky, not constellations.

beats.head: The constellations are *uneven* sizes anyway.
beats.sub: The Sun spends over six weeks in Virgo, about one in Scorpius.

beats.head: Maps get redrawn. Your *person* is still your person.
beats.sub: Send this to the friend who panicked about Ophiuchus.
